description: Codified repository of cross-discipline dependencies, interfaces, and coordination checklists

interfaces.title: HVAC Thermostat Wall Conduit & Wiring
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide a wall backbox (flush mounted at 150 cm AFF) with 20mm PVC conduit and 24V / Cat6 control wiring routed to the indoor FCU/AHU in the ceiling.

interfaces.title: Outdoor AC Condenser / Package Unit Isolator Switch
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide a heavy-duty weatherproof (IP65) rotary isolator switch within 1.0 meter of the outdoor unit, sized for 1.25 x Full Load Amps (FLA) with lockable handle.

interfaces.title: Indoor FCU / Fan Coil Unit Power Feed
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide a 1-phase 230V unswitched fused connection unit (FCU/spur) with flex outlet in the ceiling void adjacent to the indoor air unit.

interfaces.title: Fire/Smoke Damper Actuator Power & FACP Interlock
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide 24V / 230V power to duct motorized fire dampers and connect control relay module to Fire Alarm Control Panel (FACP) for auto fan shutdown upon smoke detection.

interfaces.title: Domestic Water Heater Power & DP Switch
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide a dedicated 16A/20A branch circuit wired to a 20A Double-Pole (DP) switch with neon indicator mounted outside the bathroom at 160 cm AFF.

interfaces.title: Water Booster Pump Power & Control Panel Feed
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide 3-phase or 1-phase dedicated power supply from DB to pump control panel, with cabling for pressure transmitters and low-water level float switch cut-off.

interfaces.title: Foundation Wall / Grade Beam Pipe Sleeves
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide PVC or steel pipe sleeves (diameter 50mm larger than pipe) through concrete foundation walls and grade beams with water-stop gaskets, placed BEFORE concrete pouring.

interfaces.title: Elevator Structural Pit & Sump
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Depress foundation slab by minimum 1.50 meters below lowest floor level for elevator buffer springs, and provide a 600x600x600mm sump pit for drainage.

interfaces.title: Elevator Main Feeder & Machine Room Electrical
interfaces.requirement_for_target: Provide dedicated 3-phase main feeder with lockable heavy-duty circuit breaker in machine room, plus separate 1-phase circuit for car lighting and GFCI socket in pit.
